title: UFO clippings collage: "Tracked by Radar" (London Free Press), "Six Teens Tell of 'Chase'"
description: Two-page spread of pasted newspaper clippings, led by The London Free Press headline "Tracked by Radar: UFOs Sighted Over Wide Section of District" and "Six Teens Tell of 'Chase' by Buzzing, Lighted UFOs." Other headlines include "Would You Believe 'Saucer' Visits Wichita?", "Boy Is Burned By 'Flying Ship'," "Flying Saucers, Quakes Linked," "Swamp gas still 'flying'," "Deputy Gets Too Close to 'Saucer'" and "Saucer Blast? Six Towns See Mystery." Images include a group photo, a drawing of a saucer, portrait photos and a small sketch of a saucer-shaped craft.
